questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any Healthe Care-operated hospitals and any of the Target Hospitals are close competitors in the relevant geographic region in which they operate. In your response, you may wish to consider factors such as the services and specialities available at each hospital, medical officers, facilities, location, quality of care, safety, innovation and pricing.

Please list any other hospitals, including day surgeries, that compete with the Healthe Care-operated hospitals and the Target Hospitals in the relevant geographic regions identified in response to question
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Healthe Care and/or Healthscope.
